question: Owner 2026-10-25 sub-page 策略优化: floating profit in R, closer or partial take-profit, and per-coin score sizing for the Codex 1.618 limit-reclaim rule.
worst_path: Per trade the worse of O-H-L-C and O-L-H-C; partial 50/50 = mean of 50 and 100 percent legs per path, then the worse path
R_definition: 1R = distance from the 1.618 to the 2.0 extension (0.382 of the Monday range); near-edge target = 1.618R
score: Logistic regression on features known at the fill (bucket, log vol_ratio, log approach, opp_first, monday_close_side, log liquidity, toward24, cluster24, side, range_pct), fitted on fills before 2025-01-01 with win = worst net > 0 (near-edge target); judged from 2025-01-01 by AUC, quintiles (cuts from training scores) and 1000 USDT replays: equal 10 percent, top-40 percent only, quintile-weighted 2-10 percent; gross <= 1x.
limitations: Score features exist only for the 2026-10-24 snapshot symbols; no funding, queue, margin or liquidity model.
